name: Firebird v0.60
summary: Firebird v0.60 is a mean reversion EA that trades based on price deviation from a moving average. It enters positions when price moves excessively away from its MA, expecting a reversion to the mean, and uses configurable lot sizing with optional martingale-like recovery.
summary_zh: Firebird v0.60是一个均值回归EA，基于价格偏离均线的程度进行交易。当价格过度偏离均线时入场，预期价格将回归均值，并使用可配置的手数管理及可选的马丁格尔式恢复机制。
strategy_analysis: Firebird v0.60的核心策略是均值回归，通过计算价格与移动平均线之间的偏差来识别超买超卖机会。入场条件为价格偏离均线超过设定的阈值倍数的标准差或ATR值，做多时价格需远低于均线，做空时价格需远高于均线。出场条件包括价格回归均线、固定止盈止损触发，或反向信号出现。仓位管理支持固定手数模式，也支持在亏损后加倍手数的马丁格尔恢复模式。资金管理方面提供了最大持仓限制和账户权益保护机制，但止损设置可能不够完善，在强趋势市场中面临持续逆势加仓的风险。
strategy_analysis_en: Firebird v0.60 employs a mean reversion strategy that identifies trading opportunities by measuring the deviation of price from its moving average. Entry conditions trigger when price moves beyond a configurable threshold multiple of standard deviation or ATR away from the MA — long positions when price is significantly below the MA and short positions when price is significantly above it. Exit conditions include price reverting back to the mean line, fixed take-profit or stop-loss being hit, or an opposing signal appearing. Position sizing supports both fixed lot mode and an optional martingale-style recovery mode that increases lot size after losses. Money management incorporates maximum position limits and account equity protection, however stop-loss settings may be inadequate and the strategy faces the risk of continuously adding positions against strong trends.

parameters.description: 是否启用亏损后加倍手数恢复模式
parameters.description_en: Enable lot doubling recovery mode after loss

parameters.name: Multiplier
parameters.description: 恢复模式手数倍增系数
parameters.description_en: Lot multiplier coefficient for recovery mode

pros: 均值回归策略在震荡市中表现良好，逻辑清晰易懂
提供了可配置的偏差阈值和MA周期，适应性强
包含最大持仓限制和权益保护，有一定的风险控制意识
pros_en: Mean reversion strategy performs well in ranging markets with clear and understandable logic
Configurable deviation threshold and MA period provide good adaptability to different instruments
Includes maximum position limits and equity protection showing some risk management awareness
cons: 默认止损为零，在强趋势行情中可能遭受巨大亏损
马丁格尔恢复模式在连续亏损时会导致手数指数级增长，风险极高
缺乏市场状态过滤机制，在趋势行情中仍会逆势开仓
cons_en: Default stop-loss is zero which can lead to catastrophic losses in strong trending markets
Martingale recovery mode causes exponential lot size growth during consecutive losses, extremely risky
Lacks market regime filter, continues to open counter-trend positions during trending conditions
improvements: 增加市场状态识别过滤器，在趋势行情中暂停交易或切换策略
强制设置止损，移除马丁格尔恢复模式或限制最大加倍次数
增加波动率和点差过滤器，避免在高波动和宽点差环境下入场
improvements_en: Add market regime identification filter to pause trading or switch strategy during trending conditions
Enforce mandatory stop-loss and remove martingale recovery mode or cap the maximum multiplier iterations
Add volatility and spread filters to avoid entry during high volatility and wide spread environments

risk_points: 默认无止损，单笔亏损可能无限扩大
马丁格尔恢复模式可导致手数指数级增长，连续亏损时可能爆仓
逆势交易策略在单边行情中会持续亏损并可能反复加仓
risk_points_en: Default zero stop-loss allows unlimited single-trade loss
Martingale recovery mode causes exponential lot growth, risking account blowup on consecutive losses
Counter-trend strategy keeps losing and potentially adding positions during sustained directional moves

summary_en: Firebird v0.60 is a mean reversion EA that trades based on price deviation from a moving average. It enters positions when price moves excessively away from its MA, expecting a reversion to the mean, and uses configurable lot sizing with optional martingale-like recovery.
